items.text: Projecting Ladd McConkey in but with decent injury docks; RapSheet tone bullish, status unlikely until 2:30pm ET.
items.why: Steady improvement, flak jacket expected if plays, no WR elevation.
items.implication: Startable with reduced floor due to rib docks; update projections for news.
items.opportunity: Full routes if clears, else QJ volume.

items.text: Ladd McConkey (cracked rib) is a game-time decision with optimism he can play and would wear a flak jacket; official status likely ~2:30pm ET.
items.why: Practiced Friday, improved steadily, team did not elevate WR, RapSheet bullish tone.
items.implication: Project in with injury docks for DFS/fantasy; monitor inactive window closely.
items.opportunity: If out, boost to Quentin Johnston routes/targets.

items.text: Broncos RB R.J. Harvey (hamstring) is unlikely to play vs Jaguars.
items.implication: Sit; look to backups for volume.

items.text: Ravens downgraded WR Zay Flowers to OUT vs Saints due to hamstring.
items.why: Hamstring aggravated, no practice early week.
items.implication: Sit; target share opens for others.
items.opportunity: Rashod Bateman, Mark Andrews, Isaiah Likely volume bump.

items.text: Steelers downgraded WR Michael Pittman Jr. to OUT vs Patriots due to foot injury.
items.implication: Sit; look for Steelers WR/TE alternatives.
items.opportunity: Decent look at Germie Bernard; DK Metcalf primary.

items.text: Nico Collins (hamstring) ruled OUT for Week 2 vs Bengals.
items.why: Hamstring from practice, not believed long-term but misses.
items.opportunity: Dalton Schultz, Hutchinson/Boutte/Noel targets; David Montgomery pass work.

items.text: Raiders TE Brock Bowers (knee) could return next week; doubtful this week, elevated Myarick.
items.implication: Sit this week; Mayer elevated usage.
items.opportunity: Michael Mayer TE1 upside while out.

items.text: Puka Nacua (hip) sounds like a true game-time decision.
Expecting decent look at Jonah Coleman with RJ Harvey sounding doubtful/not expected.
Expecting decent look at Germie Bernard with Michael Pittman out.
items.opportunity: Bernard target share with McCarthy scheme fit.

items.text: Joe Burrow (back) expected to play; Bengals elevated Josh Johnson as precaution.
items.why: Elevated backup but reports lean play.
items.implication: Start Burrow; monitor for any late change.

items.text: Rams consider Puka Nacua (hip) a pre-game decision for MNF vs Giants; listed questionable, no practice Fri/Sat.
items.why: Hip/groin soreness unrelated to prior psoas; true GTD.
items.implication: Have pivot ready for MNF; start if active as WR1.
items.opportunity: If out + Whittington doubtful, TE (Ferguson/Parkinson) and Konata Mumpfield/Malachi Fields bump.

items.text: Saints WR Chris Olave (hamstring) is expected to play at Baltimore.
items.implication: Start with confidence, no major docks.

items.text: Chris Olave (hamstring) sounds fine, no real docks for us.
Loves Kenneth Walker vs IND: 74% snaps, 40% target share routes in W1, Indy allowed 163 yds/3 TDs to Henry.
Loves Ashton Jeanty @ LAC: 99 utilization W1, high target share, 25+ touches recently.
Loves Justin Jefferson @ CHI: 37% target share from Wentz W1, strong history with him, soft Bears pass D.
Hates Travis Etienne @ BAL: reduced W1 workload, Kamara expected back squeezes role further, poor script as underdog.
items.implication: Fade/sit in favor of better options.
